composites.name: logistic_growth
composites.description: Logistic growth dN/dt = r*N*(1-N/K) integrated by OdeProcess; closed-form solution N(t)=K/(1+((K-N0)/N0)*exp(-r t)) is the validation oracle.

method.description: scipy solve_ivp method (LSODA, RK45, DOP853, Radau, BDF).

composites.name: lotka_volterra
composites.description: Lotka-Volterra predator-prey dx/dt = a*x - b*x*y, dy/dt = d*x*y - g*y integrated by OdeProcess; oracle is the first integral V(x,y) = d*x - g*ln(x) + b*y - a*ln(y), conserved exactly along trajectories.

method.description: scipy solve_ivp method (LSODA, RK45, DOP853, Radau, BDF).

composites.name: michaelis_menten
composites.description: Michaelis-Menten substrate depletion dS/dt = -Vmax*S/(Km+S), dP/dt = +Vmax*S/(Km+S) integrated by OdeProcess; oracles are the closed form S(t) = Km*W((S0/Km)*exp((S0 - Vmax*t)/Km)) (Lambert W) and the conserved total S+P = S0.

Km.description: Michaelis constant (concentration). Small Km/S0 makes the system stiff as S -> 0.

method.description: scipy solve_ivp method (LSODA, RK45, DOP853, Radau, BDF).

composites.name: quadratic_blowup
composites.description: Finite-time singularity dx/dt = x**2 integrated by OdeProcess; exact solution x(t) = x0/(1 - x0*t) diverges at t* = 1/x0. Negative control for the max_abs guard: the run must FAIL with a max_abs RuntimeError shortly after t*, never stall or return a finite state past t*.

max_abs.description: OdeProcess divergence bound; integration stops and raises once |x| exceeds it.

method.description: scipy solve_ivp method (LSODA, RK45, DOP853, Radau, BDF).
